$comment: HAND-AUTHORED from v0211-multi-layout-childpath.xml (Rule 10, D-030). A two-level layout tree addressed by a PATH: LayoutSpecifier="Top/Child" resolves through the parent's ChildLayouts to the child, and it is the CHILD's Dimension 4x3 and StepSize that describe the lattice, not the parent's 1x1. A resolver that stopped at the first path segment would read a 1x1 lattice against a 12-cell payload.
